summary: Intoxicated male on the tallest dune in Great Sand Dunes National Park, unable to walk down, with a female companion; NPS rangers and a CSP trooper on scene. AVSAR assisted with a litter carry down in heavy snow and cold; male transported to the hospital via ambulance, otherwise uninjured.
location: Great Sand Dunes National Park (tallest dune)
responding_agency: Alamosa Volunteer SAR (assist to National Park Service)
notes: Snowing for two days; very cold temperatures.
